notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The board is located by its drawn outline; its artwork (black stripes at 45 degrees, 99 wide at 124 spacing) is taken from the sheet's own filled shapes (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension lines, traced), ink box x 0-350, y 1-699.
